# Consent order: revised document timetable

By consent, the timetable for production of the agreed bundle is varied as set out below. The substantive obligations remain as recorded in the earlier order, and no new issue of liability is determined.

1. The index must be supplied by 15 December 2026. It must distinguish original documents from later summaries and identify any document that is available only as a copy.
2. A missing page must be described in the index. A blank substitute must not be inserted in a way that suggests that the original page was inspected and found empty.
3. Objections to the sequence of documents must be raised within three working days. An objection must identify the relevant paragraph of the existing directions and explain the proposed correction.

The agreed copying allowance is GBP 95. This amount includes ordinary binding materials. A request for additional postage must state the actual cost and must not be treated as permission to change the agreed method of delivery.

Section 6.4, article 22 and schedule 2 continue to apply. The signature fields in the accompanying template are left blank in this version.

All other directions continue to apply. There is liberty to apply concerning implementation of the revised timetable only.
